decision.claim_boundary: A development PASS means this fixed multi-sided connected-component recovery rule reconstructs the six already-development-exposed 21x21 hidden w035 patches with the frozen geometric accuracy and wrong-wrap rejection gates. It does not prove arbitrary whole-scroll recovery, complete recto coverage, Grand Prize eligibility, ink, readability, or transfer to an eligible 2027 volume. Promotion requires a separately frozen untouched holdout and then exact-prize-volume transfer.
